email.description: The email address of the user who submitted the feedback, if known.

event.description: The event the feedback is attached to.

eventID.description: The ID of the event the feedback is attached to.

id.description: The ID of the event the feedback is attached to.

eventID.description: The ID of the event the feedback is attached to.

issue.description: The issue the feedback's event belongs to. Null when the feedback isn't linked to an issue.

name.description: The name of the user who submitted the feedback. Falls back to the email address when no name is set.

user.description: The user recorded on the feedback's event. Null when the event isn't found or has no user.

id.description: The ID of the user, as sent with the event.

username.description: The username sent with the event.

email.description: The email address sent with the event.

name.description: The display name of the user: the name, email address or username sent with the event, whichever is set first.

ipAddress.description: The IP address sent with the event.

avatarUrl.description: The Gravatar URL for the user's email address.
